title: Can fixed neighbours finish the sort?
hook: The wires stay fixed while the values decide whether to swap.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Sort using alternating odd and even adjacent compare-exchange layers.

misconception: Comparators must choose their partners based on previous swaps.
objective: Sort using alternating odd and even adjacent compare-exchange layers.

claims.text: Comparator locations stay fixed while their exchanges depend on the values. The last middle comparator repairs the cross-pair disorder that the first two layers can leave behind.
